Title: The Work We Would Show First
Detail_lesson: A serious buyer gets one thing from us before they decide anything, and it is not the roadmap - it is a piece of work that already exists. Pick the one you would put in front of them, and say what it proves that a claim could not.

Title: The Capability Nobody Outside Knows We Have
Detail_lesson: Something this team can genuinely do that is hard, and that no customer, no exec deck and no job posting currently mentions. Name it, and name the last time it saved something real.

Title: The Sentence We Would Lead With
Detail_lesson: One sentence, in the words a customer would use rather than ours, saying what this team is for. Not a mission statement - the sentence you would actually say if you had ten seconds and one chance.

Title: Who Should Be Buying This and Is Not
Detail_lesson: Name a specific kind of customer, team or internal group that would benefit from what we build and does not use it today. Say what they use instead, and what you think decided that.

Title: The One Thing We Should Stop
Detail_lesson: Something we currently spend real effort on that would not be missed in six months. Name it, and say where the freed effort should go instead.
